Heard learned counsel for the revisionist/applicants, learned A.G.A. for the respondent State, and learned counsel for the respondents.

CRIMINAL REVISION No. 526 of 2023 has been filed by Smt. Meenakshi Ramchandani,
challenging the order dated2.5.2023 passed by the Additional Principal Judge-III, Family Court,
Lucknow, inComplaint Case No. 1249 of 2020 under Section 125 of the Cr.P.C., whereby the application for interim maintenance was dismissed.

Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Application U/S 482 No. 924 of 2025 has been filed by Smt. Meenakshi Ramchandani with the prayer for quashing of the impugned summoning order dated15.7.2023 and proceedings initiated on4.7.2024 inCriminal Misc. Case No. 2681 of 2021 before the Special Chief Judicial Magistrate (Custom), Lucknow.

Application U/S 482 No. 849 of 2025 has been filed by Shri Prajwal Lalchandani with the prayer for quashing of the Case No. 55605 of 2021, arising out of FIR No. 0175 of 2020 under Sections323,
504, 506, 498-A IPC andSection 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act.

All the above mentioned cases have been filed by the parties and involves matrimonial dispute,
hence, they are decided by a common judgement.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the parties that they have resolved their dispute through a settlement agreement before theMediation and Conciliation Center of this Court.
They have agreed to withdraw/not to pursue all pending cases between them.

The details of the cases Smt. Meenakshi Ramchandani vs Additional Prin. Judge Iii Family ... on 10 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/44683335/
2 have been mentioned in paragraph 6B of the settlement agreement, which reads as under:
"(i) Complaint Case No. 1249 of 2020 (Meenakshi Ramchandani (Vs. Prajwal Lalchandani) U/S 125 Cr. P. C. filed before Principal Judge, Family Court, Lucknow.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: (ii) F.I.R. No. 0175 of 2020 U/S 498A, 323, 504, 506, I.P.C. pending before ACJM-I Lucknow (iii) Case No. 5073 of 2020 U/S 12 D. V. Act pending before ACJM-I, Lucknow (iv) Case No. 3171 of 2020 U/S 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 pending before Principal Judge, Family Court, Lucknow.
(v) Complaint Case No.2681 of 2021 U/S 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. (Meena Lalchandani vs. Harish Ramchandani and others) P.S. Gazipur, Indira Nagar, Lucknow."

entities.text: Meena Lalchandani vs. Harish Ramchandani and others) P.S. Gazipur, Indira Nagar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Clause C of paragraph 6 of the agreement further states that second party has agreed not to have any objection if this Court decides the Criminal Revision No.526 of 2023 Smt. Meenakshi Ramchandani vs. State of U.P. and another in terms of this settlement agreement.

entities.text: Criminal Revision No.526 of 2023 Smt. Meenakshi Ramchandani vs. State of U.P. and another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Perused the record so also the settlement agreement, which is on record and also the report of the mediation Center.

Since the parties have amicably resolved the dispute pending between them,
which was primarily of matrimonial in nature, I am of the view that no purpose will be solved by keeping the matter pending.

Considering the above as well as law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in the case of (2008) 16 SCC 1, Gian Singh versus State of Punjab, the proceedings impugned in all the cases,
mentioned above, are liable to be and are hereby quashed.

entities.text: (2008) 16 SCC 1, Gian Singh versus State of Punjab
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: All the cases (supra) are accordingly allowed.
